proposal.summary: wkhtmlTOpdf 0.12.6 is reported vulnerable to an SSRF that allows an attacker to inject an iframe tag pointing at internal asset IP addresses, enabling access to internal assets and potential takeover of infrastructure.
proposal.cwe_quote: SSRF which allows an attacker to get initial access into the target's system by injecting iframe tag with initial asset IP address on it's source.
